name: Progressive evidence early exit on the consumed fresh two-target panel
question: Can an evidence-first progressive router stop after the first sufficient frame on both consumed sequences while retaining the sealed 2/2 routing outcome?
observed_before_freeze: DF02's previous frame alone contains the two exact high-confidence witnesses maison and chemin required by the already frozen lexical contract.
DF01's previous-frame appearance top-1 is the correct target at score 0.703153 and margin 0.050528, above the already frozen score 0.661720 and margin 0.034641 gates.
This observation makes the experiment posthoc; it cannot confirm latency or observation reduction on new sequences.

target_roster.entity_name: Département du Calvados - Direction de la Culture

thresholds.source: Unchanged minima frozen from the original four consumed positives before every open-set and transfer panel.
thresholds.rule: Emit SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY only when the sequence aggregate has unique top-1 and meets both score and margin thresholds; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.

progressive_contract.per_prefix_rule: After each new frame, first evaluate the fixed cumulative distinctive-token branch. A unique match exits; a conflict exits UNKNOWN. On NO_MATCH, evaluate the fixed appearance score for the latest frame and exit only if the unchanged score and margin gates pass; otherwise continue.
progressive_contract.no_evidence_rule: After the maximum prefix with no authorized candidate, return UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
progressive_contract.authority: Early exit changes observation work only; every emitted referent remains SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY.

research_basis: Dynamic sequence length motivates spending additional observations only where needed: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.00863
Sequence-matching receptiveness motivates predicting when temporal evidence helps instead of assuming it always does: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06840
This replay uses no learned predictor because the available panel is too small and already consumed.
execution_rule: Run once without new OCR or appearance inference. Do not tune frame order, thresholds, or stop rules after observing the derived result.

claim_boundary.allowed: Consumed Development mechanism evidence about whether the two already opened sequences could have retained their search-priority result while stopping observation earlier under one fixed progressive rule.
not_allowed: fresh confirmation, online latency, energy, compute, user-time, active-motion, provider/city generalization, learned sequence-receptiveness, or dynamic-length performance
conformal, FDR-controlled, calibrated-probability, deployment, or safety authority
exact identity, facade/portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, or user benefit
